tools.name: alcomd_list_extensions
tools.title: List installed extensions
tools.description: List installed extensions with the original Core cursor.

tools.name: alcomd_get_extension
tools.title: Get extension details
tools.description: Read the signed package identity, status, and declared entries.

tools.name: alcomd_list_extension_permissions
tools.title: List extension permissions
tools.description: Read available permissions, actual grants, and the grant revision.

tools.name: alcomd_inspect_extension_source
tools.title: Inspect an extension source
tools.description: Inspect a remote extension source and its available versions.

tools.name: alcomd_plan_extension_install
tools.title: Plan extension installation
tools.description: Inspect a local signed package and prepare its original installation plan.

tools.name: alcomd_plan_extension_install_from_source
tools.title: Plan extension installation from a source
tools.description: Prepare installation with a selected version and the inspected source fingerprint.

tools.name: alcomd_apply_extension_install
tools.title: Apply extension installation
tools.description: Apply the original plan with its fingerprint and the operator’s actual consent. Recover unknown outcomes with the original key and arguments.

tools.name: alcomd_enable_extension
tools.title: Enable an extension
tools.description: Enable the selected extension at its reviewed revision, supplying the activation digest when required.

tools.name: alcomd_disable_extension
tools.title: Disable an extension
tools.description: Disable the selected extension at its reviewed revision.

tools.name: alcomd_plan_extension_uninstall
tools.title: Plan extension removal
tools.description: Review the selected extension and the requested disposition of its data.

tools.name: alcomd_apply_extension_uninstall
tools.title: Apply extension removal
tools.description: Apply the original reviewed removal plan and return its operation.

tools.name: alcomd_grant_extension_permission
tools.title: Grant an extension permission
tools.description: Grant the reviewed permission on its specified resource at the expected grant revision.

tools.name: alcomd_revoke_extension_permission
tools.title: Revoke an extension permission
tools.description: Revoke the reviewed permission on its specified resource at the expected grant revision.
